title: Oracle Answer for Circuit Size
statement: Let $C$ be a family of Boolean circuits with $n$ input vertices, and let $v$ be a natural number. The size oracle, queried with the encoding of $n$ and the binary encoding of $v$, returns true exactly when $v$ is less than the size of the circuit for input length $n$.
